PFVArType1IEEEPFController.ovex.title: ovex

PFVArType1IEEEPFController.vitmin.title: vitmin

PFVArType1IEEEPFController.vvtmax.title: vvtmax

Ravens.cimObjectType.title: cimObjectType
Ravens.cimObjectType.description: Used in RAVENS Schema to identify the corresponding CIM Object Type of the JSON object.

IdentifiedObject.aliasName.title: aliasName
IdentifiedObject.aliasName.description:
The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

IdentifiedObject.mRID.title: mRID
IdentifiedObject.mRID.description:
Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

IdentifiedObject.name.title: name
IdentifiedObject.name.description: The name is any free human readable and possibly non unique text naming the object.

IdentifiedObject.description.title: description
IdentifiedObject.description.description: The description is a free human readable text describing or naming the object. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.

RotatingMachineDynamics.damping.title: damping
RotatingMachineDynamics.damping.description: Damping torque coefficient (D) (>= 0). A proportionality constant that, when multiplied by the angular velocity of the rotor poles with respect to the magnetic field (frequency), results in the damping torque. This value is often zero when the sources of damping torques (generator damper windings, load damping effects, etc.) are modelled in detail. Typical value = 0.

RotatingMachineDynamics.inertia.title: inertia
RotatingMachineDynamics.inertia.description: Inertia constant of generator or motor and mechanical load (H) (> 0). This is the specification for the stored energy in the rotating mass when operating at rated speed. For a generator, this includes the generator plus all other elements (turbine, exciter) on the same shaft and has units of MW x s. For a motor, it includes the motor plus its mechanical load. Conventional units are PU on the generator MVA base, usually expressed as MW x s / MVA or just s. This value is used in the accelerating power reference frame for operator training simulator solutions. Typical value = 3.

RotatingMachineDynamics.saturationFactor.title: saturationFactor
RotatingMachineDynamics.saturationFactor.description: Saturation factor at rated terminal voltage (S1) (>= 0). Not used by simplified model. Defined by defined by S(E1) in the SynchronousMachineSaturationParameters diagram. Typical value = 0,02.

RotatingMachineDynamics.saturationFactor.title: saturationFactor120
RotatingMachineDynamics.saturationFactor.description: Saturation factor at 120% of rated terminal voltage (S12) (>= RotatingMachineDynamics.saturationFactor). Not used by the simplified model, defined by S(E2) in the SynchronousMachineSaturationParameters diagram. Typical value = 0,12.

SynchronousMachineDetailed.efdBaseRatio.title: efdBaseRatio
SynchronousMachineDetailed.efdBaseRatio.description: Ratio (exciter voltage/generator voltage) of Efd bases of exciter and generator models (> 0). Typical value = 1.

SynchronousMachineDetailed.ifdBaseType.title: ifdBaseType
SynchronousMachineDetailed.ifdBaseType.description: Excitation base system mode. It should be equal to the value of WLMDV given by the user. WLMDV is the PU ratio between the field voltage and the excitation current: Efd = WLMDV x Ifd. Typical value = ifag.

SynchronousMachineDetailed.saturationFac.title: saturationFactor120QAxis
SynchronousMachineDetailed.saturationFac.description: Quadrature-axis saturation factor at 120% of rated terminal voltage (S12q) (>= SynchonousMachineDetailed.saturationFactorQAxis). Typical value = 0,12.

SynchronousMachineDetailed.saturationFac.title: saturationFactorQAxis
SynchronousMachineDetailed.saturationFac.description: Quadrature-axis saturation factor at rated terminal voltage (S1q) (>= 0). Typical value = 0,02.

SynchronousMachineTimeConstantReactance..title: ks
SynchronousMachineTimeConstantReactance..description: Saturation loading correction factor (Ks) (>= 0). Used only by type J model. Typical value = 0.

SynchronousMachineTimeConstantReactance..title: modelType
SynchronousMachineTimeConstantReactance..description: Type of synchronous machine model used in dynamic simulation applications.

SynchronousMachineTimeConstantReactance..title: rotorType
SynchronousMachineTimeConstantReactance..description: Type of rotor on physical machine.

SynchronousMachineTimeConstantReactance..title: tc
SynchronousMachineTimeConstantReactance..description: Damping time constant for ï¿½Canayï¿½ reactance (>= 0).  Typical value = 0.

SynchronousMachineTimeConstantReactance..title: tpdo
SynchronousMachineTimeConstantReactance..description: Direct-axis transient rotor time constant (T'do) (> SynchronousMachineTimeConstantReactance.tppdo). Typical value = 5.

SynchronousMachineTimeConstantReactance..title: tppdo
SynchronousMachineTimeConstantReactance..description: Direct-axis subtransient rotor time constant (T''do) (> 0). Typical value = 0,03.

SynchronousMachineTimeConstantReactance..title: tppqo
SynchronousMachineTimeConstantReactance..description: Quadrature-axis subtransient rotor time constant (T''qo) (> 0). Typical value = 0,03.

SynchronousMachineTimeConstantReactance..title: tpqo
SynchronousMachineTimeConstantReactance..description: Quadrature-axis transient rotor time constant (T'qo) (> SynchronousMachineTimeConstantReactance.tppqo). Typical value = 0,5.

SynchronousMachineTimeConstantReactance..title: xDirectSync
SynchronousMachineTimeConstantReactance..description: Direct-axis synchronous reactance (Xd) (>= SynchronousMachineTimeConstantReactance.xDirectTrans). The quotient of a sustained value of that AC component of armature voltage that is produced by the total direct-axis flux due to direct-axis armature current and the value of the AC component of this current, the machine running at rated speed. Typical value = 1,8.

SynchronousMachineTimeConstantReactance..title: xQuadSync
SynchronousMachineTimeConstantReactance..description: Quadrature-axis synchronous reactance (Xq) (>= SynchronousMachineTimeConstantReactance.xQuadTrans). The ratio of the component of reactive armature voltage, due to the quadrature-axis component of armature current, to this component of current, under steady state conditions and at rated frequency. Typical value = 1,6.

AsynchronousMachineTimeConstantReactance.title: tpo
AsynchronousMachineTimeConstantReactance.description: Transient rotor time constant (T'o) (> AsynchronousMachineTimeConstantReactance.tppo). Typical value = 5.

AsynchronousMachineTimeConstantReactance.title: tppo
AsynchronousMachineTimeConstantReactance.description: Subtransient rotor time constant (T''o) (> 0). Typical value = 0,03.

If it is negative the engine power is assumed to be unaffected by the shaft speed, but the maximum permissible fuel flow is taken to fall with falling shaft speed. UnderexcLimIEEE1.vulmin.title: vulmin
UnderexcLimIEEE1.vulmin.description: UEL output minimum limit (VULMIN) (< UnderexcLimIEEE1.vulmax). Typical value = -18.

UnderexcLimIEEE1.vurmax.title: vurmax
UnderexcLimIEEE1.vurmax.description: UEL maximum limit for radius phasor magnitude (VURMAX). Typical value = 5,8.

UnderexcLimIEEE2.k1.title: k1
UnderexcLimIEEE2.k1.description: UEL terminal voltage exponent applied to real power input to UEL limit look-up table (k1). Typical value = 2.

UnderexcLimIEEE2.k2.title: k2
UnderexcLimIEEE2.k2.description: UEL terminal voltage exponent applied to reactive power output from UEL limit look-up table (k2). Typical value = 2.

UnderexcLimIEEE2.kfb.title: kfb
UnderexcLimIEEE2.kfb.description: Gain associated with optional integrator feedback input signal to UEL (KFB). Typical value = 0.

UnderexcLimIEEE2.kuf.title: kuf
UnderexcLimIEEE2.kuf.description: UEL excitation system stabilizer gain (KUF). Typical value = 0.

UnderexcLimIEEE2.p0.title: p0
UnderexcLimIEEE2.p0.description: Real power values for endpoints (P0). Typical value = 0.

UnderexcLimIEEE2.p1.title: p1

UnderexcLimIEEE2.p2.title: p2
